basis: Three official selected document sections, directly read in one Ego source-study space

library_preflight.reused: Button result/cancel/state; short critical guidance and hidden canvas/draft preservation
library_preflight.gap: Logical focus entry/return, inactive-screen semantics and current context for plain selection buttons
library_preflight.user_direction: Selection screen to one large workspace to explicit return; permanent tab row replaced

sources.title: WAI Button Pattern
sources.read_scope: Following button activation focus paragraphs and button roles
sources.observed: Context-changing actions may move focus to the starting point; unchanged-context actions often keep focus
sources.application_proposal: Reveal workspace then logical start; return to opener/fallback is application proposal, not dialog trap

sources.title: Understanding Focus Order 2.4.3
sources.read_scope: SC/Intent, dynamic content and static focus target selected paragraphs
sources.observed: Order preserves meaning and operability, without universally mandating one destination
sources.application_proposal: Logical heading/control and meaningful visual order; no redundant tab stops

sources.title: HTML hidden attribute
sources.read_scope: Hidden state, CSS override, until-found and scripts/form controls selected paragraphs
sources.observed: Hidden removes currently irrelevant state from rendering but scripts/form controls can remain active
sources.application_proposal: Hide inactive current-state screen, preserve data, prevent hidden focus; no assumption of async cancellation

cross_checks: No tab roles or tab arrow-key rules for normal selection buttons
Focus destination is a proposal; Focus Order does not mandate an exact heading
Nonmodal workspace does not imply modal dialog/focus trapping
Hidden state does not erase model, save data or cancel asynchronous writes
Native input focus and TalkBack focus require separate actual validation
not_verified: Input/draft/photo/coordinate preservation in actual new UI
